resolution.note: gauge reads the last message iteration of usage.iterations; verbatim advisor-turn capture reads 66451 (was 131420)

title: The context gauge reads the last executor iteration, not the advisor-turn sum
body:
Source: operator report 2026-11-16 from boilerplate-2026: PostToolUse gauge asked for a handoff at '162k of 400k' while the real context was ~82k. Capture .krn/runs/lead/advisor-usage.jsonl (this repo's lead transcript): a turn that calls the advisor carries usage.iterations [message, advisor_message, message]; the top-level input/cache counters are the sum of both executor iterations (cache_read 62311+64967=127278), so gaugeReading in src/context/gauge.ts reports ~131k for a ~66k context.
Outcome: gaugeReading takes the prompt size from the last usage.iterations entry of type message when iterations are present (top-level counters otherwise); on the capture it reports 66451, not 131420.
Why: a doubled reading forces handoffs at half the budget in every adopted repository; leads do almost nothing per session.
Proof: node --test test/context/gauge.test.ts with the verbatim capture line.
Files: src/context/gauge.ts
